evidence: Runtime facts vs test.sh: entry/start command -- integration.md:3 'Node 22 running /app/server.js as an ordinary user and not necessarily from inside /app, so find your own files relative to server.js' matches test.sh:127-141 (setpriv uid 65534, node $APP_ENTRY, possibly /tmp/submission copy); port -- integration.md:3 '0.0.0.0 port 3000' = test.sh PORT=3000 and app_context URL localhost:3000; storage -- instruction.md:5 '/app/app.db' and integration.md:3 'or at the path in DB_PATH when that is set' = test.sh:128,139; env -- integration.md:3 lists exactly PATH, NODE_PATH, HOME (may not be /app), PORT=3000, DB_PATH = test.sh:134-139 env -i; health -- integration.md:3 'GET /api/health should answer 200 even if the database can't be opened' = test.sh probe_ready; fixed clock -- integration.md:7 '2026-05-12T11:00:00Z' = seed clock and judge app_context; seed -- instruction.md:5 and integration.md:5 '/assets/seed_data.json ... import it once into an empty database', restart persistence list incl. unread positions/walls (graded by persistence criterion and restart_app); accounts/password/roles -- walls-and-retention.md:3-15 (password123, five accounts, Dev walled from M-12) = app_context.md accounts; symlink rule integration.md:5 is stricter than test.sh:102-113 (which only tolerates internal node_modules links), so a compliant app is never zeroed. Network is public (task.toml network_mode public) and integration.md:3 allows CDN assets, so no offline constraint is needed. Graded-vs-asked sweep over all 2 gate, 16 functional, 6 polish and 4 visual criteria found a public basis for each demand: walls on every route incl. snippets/quotes/unread/mentions/links/transcripts and plain 'not available' (walls-and-retention.md:17), live wall within ~10 s (:19), timer options off/1/7/30 shown beside title, exact-age boundary, edit not making younger, shorten deletes at once, never restore (:23), deletion takes versions/quotes with placeholder (:25), partner-only holds scoped to exactly one message, release applies at once, typed 'On hold' not a mark (:29; conversations.md:13), case-insensitive literal substring search without earlier versions and transcript heading/generated time/sent times/edited/hold/versions/no chat controls (:33-35), refusal reason stays in place (:37, used by stale edit and polish refusal_in_place), nesting 3 deep with quotes and parent-ordered placement and same-matter replies (conversations.md:5), edited mark, staff version viewer, delete confirm, stale-edit refusal keeping typed text (:9), formatting set incl. links in new tab and literal markup everywhere (:13), copyable message links with preview/'not available' and persistent highlight (:17), @ mentions by first name any case, matter-scoped suggestions, mentions list following edits/deletes (:21), per-user unread synced across tabs, new-messages line, mark unread, deleted not counted (:25), Enter/Shift+Enter/Escape (:29), duplicate send appears once and same-time order consistent in thread/search/transcript (:31), ~10 s live updates preserving draft/scroll/open thread (:33), 390 px phone (:35), signed-out sees nothing / server returns nothing to anonymous (instruction.md:7; integration.md:9). Seed supports every seeded fact the criteria cite (M-11 7-day with K-10 at 11:00:00Z and K-11 one second later, K-1 expired with K-14/K-15 replies, K-2 versions 'Landlords notice recieved.', K-17 held, M-13 30-day with K-13 version 2,400 and K-18 on 3 May, M-12 title/Fenwick/heads of terms). Counterexample attempts: a broken app that omits health/DB_PATH/relative-path handling fails at test.sh readiness or persistence, which the brief warned about; a conforming alternative (different routes, cookie names, idempotency by key or content, link-preview format, confirm via native dialog, matter list on its own screen) is explicitly tolerated by the prompts ('Any endpoint path, payload shape or cookie name is acceptable'; 'in the page or as a browser dialog'; visual 'beside the thread or on its own screen'). Non-blocking observations: (1) a sign-out control is used by functional signin_and_client_scope Part A and polish refusal_in_place but is not named in the brief; it is implied by 'sign in as different people' through the pages and by the signed-in/signed-out access rules, and the skill lists an identity surface by house convention as a known false positive. (2) Cross-tab unread sync is required within ~10 s; the brief says the count 'is the same in every tab' and gives ~10 s for live changes, which reasonably covers it. Source-level review only; the mechanical half (check-runtime-contract-strings.py) belongs to the deterministic reviewer and no run evidence is needed for this row.
